rules.title: Residential Rental Property Application Fee Limit
rules.requirement: Landlords and their agents are prohibited from charging a residential rental application or screening fee exceeding $50, subject to annual CPI adjustments.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental properties generally, with explicit exemptions for one-family or two-family dwellings offered for rent and real estate licensees who are not the landlord.

rules.exemptions: One-family or two-family dwellings offered for rent, and real estate commission licensees who are not the landlord.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
